info.name: The Muse Public Companies Jobs API

params.name: page
params.description: Page number of results to return (0-indexed pagination cursor).

params.name: descending
params.description: Sort results in descending order when true.

params.name: category
params.description: Filter by job category, for example "Data Science", "Design", "Software Engineering", "Sales", or "Accounting". Repeat the parameter to filter on multiple categories.

params.name: level
params.description: Filter by experience level. One of "Entry Level", "Mid Level", "Senior Level", "Management", or "Internship". Repeat the parameter to filter on multiple levels.

params.name: company
params.description: Filter by company short name (for example "hartfordhealthcare"). Repeat the parameter to filter on multiple companies.

params.name: location
params.description: Filter by location, for example "New York, NY" or "Flexible / Remote". Repeat the parameter to filter on multiple locations.

params.name: api_key
params.description: Optional API key that raises the hourly rate limit.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of job openings intelligently sorted by factors such as trendiness, uniqueness, and newness. Supports filtering by category, experience level, company, and location. Multiple values may be supplied for `category`, `level`, `company`, and `location` by repeating the query parameter. Returns up to 20 results per page.

params.name: id
params.description: The numeric ID of the job.

params.name: api_key
params.description: Optional API key that raises the hourly rate limit.

items.docs: Retrieves a single job opening by its numeric ID.
